note: Gzipped bytes a consumer downloads per component, counted transitively: the component's chunk plus every shared chunk and stylesheet it imports. A ratchet, not a ceiling — the check fails when one rises past its tolerance and when one drops well below without this file being tightened. Run `node scripts/component-size.mjs write` after a deliberate change. Moved 2026-08-27 for the Form work: every field component rose about 0.45 KB, which is the form integration itself — the context, the error resolution and the registration effect. The first version of that change cost 2.44 KB each instead, because `Field` imported `useFormContext` from `Form.tsx` and so dragged `Form.Summary`, its string-table use and `Form.css` into every page with one TextField. This gate is what found it; `packages/ui/src/components/_form-context.ts` is the fix. Added 2026-08-27: EmptyState at 0.89 KB, AvatarGroup at 1.85 KB, and SplitButton at 5.60 KB — the last carries Menu, because its popup is a Menu and its parts are Menu's re-exported rather than a second copy of them.
